svg.title: Stepwise ablation of the inference harness
svg.desc: Panel A defines four cumulative configurations from the single prompt baseline through the full harness. Panel B reports earlier, later, and tie counts with exact unadjusted P values for 120 blinded comparisons by one nonphysician OpenAI LLM judge.

g.text: 40 notes per comparison. Ties were excluded from two sided exact sign tests. The three P values are unadjusted.
